create.title: Exact adjacent-odd decomposition and unmatched-row capacity obstruction
create.statement_tex: Let Y=R^2 asymp sqrt(X), let J=[A,B] intersect Z have length at most R, and restrict R/4<h<=R/2. For each h the odd-denominator row Q_h={q odd:hq in J} has size 0, 1, or 2. A two-point row is uniquely {q,q+2}, exists exactly when A<=hq and h(q+2)<=B, and equals chi_4(q)e(sqrt(Xhq)){A_X(h,q)-A_X(h,q+2)e(Theta_h(q))}, where Theta_h(q)=2sqrt(Xh)/(sqrt(q+2)+sqrt(q)) asymp hR. One-point rows remain full unmatched terms, with only inherited angular or radial equalities starred. On smooth actual-profile pieces the adjacent amplitude difference is O(h/R^2) and totals O(1), but the phase bracket has no automatic modulo-one saving and seam rows remain explicit. For infinitely many X=K^4, a strict star-free top-profile length-K window has >>R unmatched rows of amplitude at least 1/2. Thus adjacent pairing followed by endpoint counting or absolute values retains R capacity against the sqrt(R) target. This is not a signed lower bound; the full cross-h matched-plus-unmatched hyperbola sum remains open.
create.next_action: Keep the complete matched and unmatched h rows signed. Derive the exact hyperbola-floor/sawtooth representation of q_h and test a two-variable cross-h estimate; do not take rowwise absolute values or assume universal pairing.

update.next_action: On R/4<h<=R/2, prove the signed matched-plus-unmatched hyperbola-floor sum of unweighted size sqrt(R), retaining the exact actual amplitude and window endpoints. Treat (log X)^B<h<=R/4 separately.
The first cross-residue local test is now complete and fails after absolute values. Preserve the full signed cross-h matched-plus-unmatched selector.
First solve the physical signed hyperbola-floor core. Adjacent character pairing supplies no alpha transfer or height-limit theorem.

reject.reason: Pair availability requires both window inequalities. A strict actual top-profile family has order R unmatched rows.
The pair contains the factor 1-e(Theta_h(q)); Theta_h(q) has scale hR but no automatic control modulo one, and admissible fourth-power rows are bounded away from integers.
Artificial window edges are full owners, and an actual star-free plateau family has unmatched absolute mass >>R rather than O(sqrt(R)).

no_change.reason: The signed high shell, lower h sector, and alpha transfer remain open.
The exact decomposition and obstruction prove no new discrepancy exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 57 makes the first cross-residue local interaction exact and proves with a strict actual-profile family that adjacent pairing plus absolute values cannot supply the missing square root. It isolates the signed cross-h hyperbola-floor sum but proves no shell estimate or exponent.
